blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippines saw a “policy surge” supporting renewable energy expansion during the Middle East war, outpacing other Southeast Asian countries, according to a study. Zero Carbon Analytics, an international climate and energy research organization, said the Philippines adopted 13 renewable energy policies between February and August of this year. READ: DOE eyes additional 20 GW to hit 2040 renewables goal During the period, the group logged 37 clean energy policies across the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Singapore, and Vietnam.
